entities.summary: Kim Dong-hee is a South Korean actor under NPIO Entertainment. He is best known for his acting in hit Korean television series such as Sky Castle (2019), Itaewon Class  (2020), A-Teen (2018), A-Teen 2 (2019), and Netflix's original series Extracurricular (2020).
